# Waymark 0.3.0 preview

A coordinated interface refresh for the desktop companion, inspired by AION 2’s map and menu styling.

- Dark slate panels, ivory headings and restrained gold accents throughout the app and floating minimap.
- More room for the map, quieter toolbars and a consistent desktop navigation rail at smaller window sizes.
- Compact, equal-size pet cards with clearer progress and expandable farming details. Completed pets show a full progress bar.
- Settings split into General, Updates, Data & backups, Connection and Advanced. The selected section is remembered; backup tools appear before progress reset.
- Clearable search fields, helpful loading and empty states, saved inventory filters and improved keyboard focus in dialogs.
- New workspaces start with feathers, travel, dungeons and strongholds enabled. Existing layer choices, follow settings, minimap placement, routes, pins and progress are preserved.
- One Abyss entry in map selectors; the detected internal layer is retained.

This is a preview release. Live tracking and collection-reader coverage are unchanged; this release does not make new claims about automatic completion detection or Abyss validation.
